_comment: PII linter hook for Tencent CodeBuddy.
Install: `pii-lint install-hooks codebuddy` merges this into
PostToolUse: after CodeBuddy writes/edits a file, scan it. The env
var $CODEBUDDY_TOOL_FILE_PATH is set when the hook fires.
Exit 2 on HIGH+ to force CodeBuddy to redact.
Stop:        at end-of-turn, scan the staged diff. Exit 2 forces
cleanup before the agent signs off.

hooks.command: bash -c 'f="$CODEBUDDY_TOOL_FILE_PATH"; case "$f" in *.csv|*.jsonl|*.md) pii-lint scan -- "$f" || exit 2;; esac'
